title: Never lose a WhatsApp lead again: Zoho CRM WhatsApp Integration #Shorts
description:
Learn how to connect WhatsApp Business to Zoho SalesIQ and CRM so every first customer message automatically creates a lead with an AI-generated chat summary.

1. Navigate to Zoho SalesIQ Settings, then Integrations, and connect your WhatsApp Business account.
2. Configure the assignment rule to automatically create a new CRM Lead on the first incoming message.
3. Enable the AI summary feature so chat history is automatically appended to the lead notes.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho SalesIQ WhatsApp API Connector
- endpoint: POST /salesiq/v2/channels/whatsapp/webhook
- scope: ZohoSalesIQ.fullaccess.all
- docs: Zoho SalesIQ API Guide

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
